name: Ushiromiya George
source:
[url=/c228]Eva[/url] and Hideyoshi's son. He is the oldest of [url=/c200]Kinzou's[/url] grandchildren, and an exceptional and diligent young adult. He was brought up by Eva specifically with the family headship in mind, works at his father's company as an apprentice, and is a skilled martial artist like his mother. He respects his parents greatly, though he admittedly finds his mother overbearing. 

George is admired by everyone in his family, especially his cousins, who view him as their older brother and peacemaker.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Umineko_no_Naku_Koro_ni_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
